channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, Curator, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, Curator, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.
